title: Visits Kept on a Self-Pay Visit Package for the Holder's Own Appointment Schedule
content:
**Scheduling desk rule — transfers out of a Self-Pay Visit Package.** Visits for the holder's own schedule are kept back from a transfer: where the Appointment Series the package funds is active or booked, every appointment still booked on it is kept back; where that series is paused, its booked appointments stand suspended and one week of its standing schedule is kept back instead, as many visits as the series' standing visits per week; where there is no such open series, none are kept back. The visits kept back are subtracted from the standing visits, and the count of visits that move never goes below zero.

**Series status table (the Appointment Series linked to the package)**

| Series status | Visits kept back for the holder's schedule |
|---|---|
| active | the appointments still booked on the series |
| booked | the appointments still booked on the series |
| paused | the series' standing visits per week (booked appointments suspended) |
| completed | none |
| cancelled | none |
| no series funded by the package | none |

**Hypothetical cases**

- Active series with 4 appointments still booked: 4 visits kept back.
- Paused series standing at 2 visits per week, with 5 appointments booked before the pause: 2 visits kept back.
- Completed series: none kept back.
- Standing visits 3, active series with 5 appointments still booked: 3 less 5 would be negative, so no visits move.
